name_vi: Hộp mây cuộn đồng hồ du lịch
description_en: A horizontal cylindrical woven case with hinged top half, padded three-bay interior and leather tie straps. Canonical front: two leather tie straps over the cylindrical lid. Side view: a round end profile split by the hinge line. Rear view: the full-length fabric hinge and leather strap anchors. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A horizontal cylindrical woven case with hinged top half, padded three-bay interior and leather tie straps. Canonical front: two leather tie straps over the cylindrical lid. Side view: a round end profile split by the hinge line. Rear view: the full-length fabric hinge and leather strap anchors. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Boho: organic graceful curves and restrained craft detail. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: plain over-one-under-one basket weave. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
